description: Read-only reference implementations for a Codex MCP lookup tool.

map.description: Apply a pure function to every element, preserving order.

parallel_stl.requires: C++17; default-constructible/assignable result; thread-safe pure callable

tabulate.description: Generate n elements by applying f(i) to indices 0..n-1.

parallel_stl.requires: C++17; default-constructible/assignable result; thread-safe pure callable

reduce.description: Combine elements and an identity with a parallel reduction.

parallel_stl.requires: C++17; associative and commutative op, valid identity; pure callable

filter.description: Select matching elements and retain their input order.

sort.description: Return a sorted copy using a parallel sorting algorithm.

parallel_stl.requires: C++17; pure strict-weak-order comparator; sort is not stable
